008package paint.viewer.ui.dialogs;
009import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
010
011
012import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
013
014import javax.swing.*;
015import java.awt.*;
016import java.util.*;
017import java.util.List;
018import java.util.function.Function;
019import java.util.stream.Collectors;
020
021/**
022 * Modal dialog to filter a list of {@link RecordingEntry} objects by metadata.
023 * <p>
024 * Supports multi-column filtering with dynamic cross-filtering, allowing users to
025 * refine recording sets based on Cell Type, Probe Name, Probe Type, Adjuvant,
026 * and Concentration.
027 */
028public class RecordingFilterDialog extends JDialog {
029
030    // ----- Data sets -----
031    private final List<RecordingEntry> originalRecordings; // full dataset (for Reset All)
032    private       List<RecordingEntry> filteredRecordings; // current filtered result
033
034    // ----- UI lists -----
035    private final JList<String> cellTypeList;
036    private final JList<String> probeNameList;
037    private final JList<String> probeTypeList;
038    private final JList<String> adjuvantList;
039    private final JList<String> concentrationList;
040
041    // ----- Book-keeping for highlighting and per-column behavior -----
042    private final Map<JList<String>, JPanel> listPanels                                = new HashMap<>();
043    private final Map<JList<String>, JButton> resetButtons                             = new HashMap<>();
044    private final Map<JList<String>, String> titles                                    = new HashMap<>();
045    private final Map<JList<String>, Function<RecordingEntry, String>> valueExtractors = new HashMap<>();
046    private final Map<JList<String>, List<String>> selections                          = new HashMap<>();
047    private final Set<JList<String>> activeFilters                                     = new HashSet<>();
048
049    private       boolean            cancelled                                         = true;
050
051    /**
052     * Constructs a new filter dialog.
053     *
054     * @param owner                    the parent frame
055     * @param currentVisibleRecordings the recordings currently shown in the viewer
056     * @param allRecordings           all available recordings in the project
057     * @param initialCriteria         previously applied filter criteria (optional)
058     */
059    public RecordingFilterDialog(Frame owner,
060                                 List<RecordingEntry> currentVisibleRecordings,
061                                 List<RecordingEntry> allRecordings,
062                                 FilterCriteria initialCriteria) {
063        super(owner, "Filter Recordings", true);
064
065        final FilterCriteria criteria = (initialCriteria == null) ? FilterCriteria.empty() : initialCriteria;
066
067        setLayout(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
068        setResizable(false);
069
070        // Store full dataset
071        this.originalRecordings = new ArrayList<>(allRecordings);
072
073        // Compute the base list (start subset) from the current visible subset and incoming criteria
074        // visible subset when dialog opened
075        List<RecordingEntry> baseList;
076        if (criteria.isNotEmpty()) {
077            baseList = currentVisibleRecordings.stream()
078                                               .filter(e -> criteria.cellTypes.isEmpty()      || criteria.cellTypes.contains(e.getCellType()))
079                                               .filter(e -> criteria.probeNames.isEmpty()     || criteria.probeNames.contains(e.getProbeName()))
080                                               .filter(e -> criteria.probeTypes.isEmpty()     || criteria.probeTypes.contains(e.getProbeType()))
081                                               .filter(e -> criteria.adjuvants.isEmpty()      || criteria.adjuvants.contains(e.getAdjuvant()))
082                                               .filter(e -> criteria.concentrations.isEmpty() || criteria.concentrations.contains(String.valueOf(e.getConcentration())))
083                                               .collect(Collectors.toList());
084        } else {
085            baseList = new ArrayList<>(currentVisibleRecordings);
086        }
087
088        this.filteredRecordings = new ArrayList<>(baseList);
089
090        // Build initial list box contents from baseList (not the full dataset)
091        Set<String> cellTypes      = baseList.stream()
092                                             .map(RecordingEntry::getCellType)
093                                             .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
094        Set<String> probeNames     = baseList.stream()
095                                             .map(RecordingEntry::getProbeName)
096                                             .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
097        Set<String> probeTypes     = baseList.stream()
098                                             .map(RecordingEntry::getProbeType)
099                                             .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
100        Set<String> adjuvants      = baseList.stream()
101                                             .map(RecordingEntry::getAdjuvant)
102                                             .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
103        Set<String> concentrations = baseList.stream()
104                                             .map(e -> String.valueOf(e.getConcentration()))
105                                             .collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
106
107        cellTypeList      = createList(cellTypes);
108        probeNameList     = createList(probeNames);
109        probeTypeList     = createList(probeTypes);
110        adjuvantList      = createList(adjuvants);
111        concentrationList = createList(concentrations);
112
113        // Register metadata for each list box
114        titles.put(cellTypeList,      CELL_TYPE);
115        titles.put(probeNameList,     PROBE_NAME);
116        titles.put(probeTypeList,     PROBE_TYPE);
117        titles.put(adjuvantList,      ADJUVANT);
118        titles.put(concentrationList, CONCENTRATION);
119
120        valueExtractors.put(cellTypeList,      RecordingEntry::getCellType);
121        valueExtractors.put(probeNameList,     RecordingEntry::getProbeName);
122        valueExtractors.put(probeTypeList,     RecordingEntry::getProbeType);
123        valueExtractors.put(adjuvantList,      RecordingEntry::getAdjuvant);
124        valueExtractors.put(concentrationList, e -> String.valueOf(e.getConcentration()));
125
126        // main lists row
127        JPanel listPanel = new JPanel(new GridLayout(1, 6, 10, 0));
128        listPanel.add(createListBoxWithButtons(cellTypeList));
129        listPanel.add(createListBoxWithButtons(probeNameList));
130        listPanel.add(createListBoxWithButtons(probeTypeList));
131        listPanel.add(createListBoxWithButtons(adjuvantList));
132        listPanel.add(createListBoxWithButtons(concentrationList));
133
134        // Right controls
135        JPanel rightButtonPanel = new JPanel();
136        rightButtonPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(rightButtonPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
137
138        JButton applyButton    = new JButton("Apply");
139        JButton resetAllButton = new JButton("Reset All");
140        JButton cancelButton   = new JButton("Cancel");
141
142        Dimension btnSize = new Dimension(100, 30);
143        applyButton.setMaximumSize(btnSize);
144        resetAllButton.setMaximumSize(btnSize);
145        cancelButton.setMaximumSize(btnSize);
146
147        applyButton.addActionListener(e -> {
148            applyAction();
149        });
150
151        resetAllButton.addActionListener(e -> {
152            // Reset everything to the full dataset, clear all selections and highlights
153            filteredRecordings = new ArrayList<>(originalRecordings);
154            updateAllListsFrom(filteredRecordings);
155
156            // Clear remembered selections and active filter flags
157            for (JList<String> l : selections.keySet()) {
158                selections.put(l, Collections.emptyList());
159                l.clearSelection();
160            }
161            activeFilters.clear();
162            updateResetButtonStates();
163        });
164
165        cancelButton.addActionListener(e -> {
166            cancelled = true;
167            dispose();
168        });
169
170        rightButtonPanel.add(applyButton);
171        rightButtonPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
172        rightButtonPanel.add(resetAllButton);
173        rightButtonPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
174        rightButtonPanel.add(cancelButton);
175        rightButtonPanel.add(Box.createVerticalGlue());
176
177        listPanel.add(rightButtonPanel);
178        add(listPanel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
179        pack();
180        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
181
182        // Initialize the selection map with empties
183        for (JList<String> l : Arrays.asList(cellTypeList, probeNameList, probeTypeList, adjuvantList, concentrationList)) {
184            selections.put(l, Collections.emptyList());
185        }
186
187        // Restore incoming criteria -> selections/activeFilters, apply, and highlight
188        if (criteria.isNotEmpty()) {
189            restoreSelectionsFromCriteria(criteria);
190            filteredRecordings = applyAllFilters(); // apply all selected lists
191            updateAllListsFrom(filteredRecordings);
192        }
193        updateResetButtonStates();
194
195        // Make sure that pressing the red close button does the same as Cancel.
196        setDefaultCloseOperation(WindowConstants.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE);
197        addWindowListener(new java.awt.event.WindowAdapter() {
198            @Override
199            public void windowClosing(java.awt.event.WindowEvent e) {
200                cancelAction();
201            }
202        });
203    }
204
205    // ===== UI helpers =====
206
207    private JList<String> createList(Set<String> values) {
208        JList<String> list = new JList<>(values.toArray(new String[0]));
209        list.setSelectionMode(ListSelectionModel.MULTIPLE_INTERVAL_SELECTION);
210        list.setVisibleRowCount(5);
211        return list;
212    }
213
214    private JPanel createListBoxWithButtons(JList<String> list) {
215        String title = titles.get(list);
216
217        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
218        panel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder(title));
219        listPanels.put(list, panel);
220
221        JScrollPane scrollPane = new JScrollPane(list);
222        scrollPane.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(140, 170));
223        panel.add(scrollPane, BorderLayout.CENTER);
224
225        JPanel btnPanel   = new JPanel(new GridLayout(2, 1, 0, 5));
226        JButton filterBtn = new JButton("Filter");
227        JButton resetBtn  = new JButton("Reset");
228        resetBtn.setEnabled(false); // initially disabled
229        resetButtons.put(list, resetBtn);
230
231        filterBtn.addActionListener(e -> onFilterClicked(list));
232        resetBtn.addActionListener(e -> onResetClicked(list));
233
234        btnPanel.add(filterBtn);
235        btnPanel.add(resetBtn);
236        panel.add(btnPanel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
237        return panel;
238    }
239
240    // ===== Button handlers =====
241
242    private void onFilterClicked(JList<String> list) {
243        List<String> selected = list.getSelectedValuesList();
244        if (selected == null || selected.isEmpty()) {
245            return;
246        }
247
248        // Remember this column’s selection and mark it as active
249        selections.put(list, new ArrayList<>(selected));
250        activeFilters.add(list);
251
252        // Recompute from the full dataset (so filters stack properly)
253        filteredRecordings = applyAllFilters();
254
255        // Update visible lists to reflect the new filtered set
256        updateAllListsFrom(filteredRecordings);
257
258        // Restore previous selections for *all* active lists
259        for (Map.Entry<JList<String>, List<String>> entry : selections.entrySet()) {
260            reselect(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
261        }
262
263        // Update borders (highlight active lists)
264        updateResetButtonStates();
265    }
266
267    private void onResetClicked(JList<String> list) {
268        // Clear only THIS column’s selection and flag
269        selections.put(list, Collections.emptyList());
270        activeFilters.remove(list);
271
272        // Re-apply the remaining active filters to the base list
273        filteredRecordings = applyAllFilters();
274
275        // Update UI lists from the recomputed working set
276        updateAllListsFrom(filteredRecordings);
277
278        // Clear selection on this list; preserve selections on others
279        list.clearSelection();
280        for (Map.Entry<JList<String>, List<String>> e : selections.entrySet()) {
281            if (!e.getKey().equals(list) && !e.getValue().isEmpty()) {
282                reselect(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
283            }
284        }
285        updateResetButtonStates();
286    }
287
288    // ===== Core filtering =====
289
290    /**
291     * Apply all currently active filters (as recorded in 'selections') to the baseList.
292     */
293    private List<RecordingEntry> applyAllFilters() {
294        // Always reapply filters to the full dataset, not the baseList.
295        List<RecordingEntry> current = new ArrayList<>(originalRecordings);
296        for (Map.Entry<JList<String>, List<String>> entry : selections.entrySet()) {
297            JList<String> l = entry.getKey();
298            List<String> sel = entry.getValue();
299            if (sel == null || sel.isEmpty()) {
300                continue;
301            }
302
303            Function<RecordingEntry, String> extractor = valueExtractors.get(l);
304            current = current.stream()
305                    .filter(r -> sel.contains(extractor.apply(r)))
306                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
307        }
308        return current;
309    }
310
311    // ===== List content updates =====
312
313    private void updateAllListsFrom(List<RecordingEntry> source) {
314        updateList(cellTypeList,      collectDistinct(source, valueExtractors.get(cellTypeList)));
315        updateList(probeNameList,     collectDistinct(source, valueExtractors.get(probeNameList)));
316        updateList(probeTypeList,     collectDistinct(source, valueExtractors.get(probeTypeList)));
317        updateList(adjuvantList,      collectDistinct(source, valueExtractors.get(adjuvantList)));
318        updateList(concentrationList, collectDistinct(source, valueExtractors.get(concentrationList)));
319    }
320
321    private Set<String> collectDistinct(List<RecordingEntry> src, Function<RecordingEntry, String> fn) {
322        return src.stream().map(fn).collect(Collectors.toCollection(TreeSet::new));
323    }
324
325    private void updateList(JList<String> list, Set<String> values) {
326        list.setListData(values.toArray(new String[0]));
327    }
328
329    private void reselect(JList<String> list, List<String> values) {
330        if (values == null || values.isEmpty()) {
331            list.clearSelection();
332            return;
333        }
334        ListModel<String> model = list.getModel();
335        java.util.List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
336        for (int i = 0; i < model.getSize(); i++) {
337            String v = model.getElementAt(i);
338            if (values.contains(v)) {
339                indices.add(i);
340            }
341        }
342        int[] idxArr = indices.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
343        list.setSelectedIndices(idxArr);
344    }
345
346    // ===== Visual highlighting =====
347
348    private void updateResetButtonStates() {
349        for (Map.Entry<JList<String>, JButton> e : resetButtons.entrySet()) {
350            JList<String> list = e.getKey();
351            JButton button = e.getValue();
352            button.setEnabled(activeFilters.contains(list));
353        }
354    }
355
356    // ===== Criteria restore =====
357
358    private void restoreSelectionsFromCriteria(FilterCriteria filterCriteria) {
359        // Copy criteria into the selection map and mark active filters
360        setSelectionFrom(cellTypeList,      filterCriteria.cellTypes);
361        setSelectionFrom(probeNameList,     filterCriteria.probeNames);
362        setSelectionFrom(probeTypeList,     filterCriteria.probeTypes);
363        setSelectionFrom(adjuvantList,      filterCriteria.adjuvants);
364        setSelectionFrom(concentrationList, filterCriteria.concentrations);
365
366        // Reflect those selections in the JLists
367        reselect(cellTypeList,      selections.get(cellTypeList));
368        reselect(probeNameList,     selections.get(probeNameList));
369        reselect(probeTypeList,     selections.get(probeTypeList));
370        reselect(adjuvantList,      selections.get(adjuvantList));
371        reselect(concentrationList, selections.get(concentrationList));
372    }
373
374    private void setSelectionFrom(JList<String> list, List<String> values) {
375        if (values != null && !values.isEmpty()) {
376            selections.put(list, new ArrayList<>(values));
377            activeFilters.add(list);
378        } else {
379            selections.put(list, Collections.emptyList());
380            activeFilters.remove(list);
381        }
382    }
383
384    // ===== Getters =====
385
386    public List<RecordingEntry> getFilteredRecordings() {
387        return filteredRecordings;
388    }
389
390    public boolean isCancelled() {
391        return cancelled;
392    }

394    // ===== Criteria I/O =====
395
396    /**
397     * Data class holding selected filter criteria for recordings.
398     */
399    public static class FilterCriteria {
400        /** Selected cell types. */
401        public final List<String> cellTypes;
402        /** Selected probe names. */
403        public final List<String> probeNames;
404        /** Selected probe types. */
405        public final List<String> probeTypes;
406        /** Selected adjuvants. */
407        public final List<String> adjuvants;
408        /** Selected concentrations (stored as strings). */
409        public final List<String> concentrations;
410
411        /**
412         * Constructs a new {@code FilterCriteria} instance.
413         *
414         * @param cellTypes      list of selected cell types
415         * @param probeNames     list of selected probe names
416         * @param probeTypes     list of selected probe types
417         * @param adjuvants      list of selected adjuvants
418         * @param concentrations list of selected concentrations
419         */
420        public FilterCriteria(List<String> cellTypes,
421                              List<String> probeNames,
422                              List<String> probeTypes,
423                              List<String> adjuvants,
424                              List<String> concentrations) {
425            this.cellTypes      = cellTypes;
426            this.probeNames     = probeNames;
427            this.probeTypes     = probeTypes;
428            this.adjuvants      = adjuvants;
429            this.concentrations = concentrations;
430        }
431
432        /** @return a new empty filter criteria object */
433        public static FilterCriteria empty() {
434            return new FilterCriteria(
435                    Collections.emptyList(),
436                    Collections.emptyList(),
437                    Collections.emptyList(),
438                    Collections.emptyList(),
439                    Collections.emptyList()
440            );
441        }
442
443        /** @return true if no filters are active */
444        public boolean isEmpty() {
445            return cellTypes.isEmpty()
446                    && probeNames.isEmpty()
447                    && probeTypes.isEmpty()
448                    && adjuvants.isEmpty()
449                    && concentrations.isEmpty();
450        }
451
452        /** @return true if any filter is active */
453        public boolean isNotEmpty() {
454            return !isEmpty();
455        }
456    }
457
458    public FilterCriteria getCurrentFilterCriteria() {
459        return new FilterCriteria(
460                selections.get(cellTypeList),
461                selections.get(probeNameList),
462                selections.get(probeTypeList),
463                selections.get(adjuvantList),
464                selections.get(concentrationList)
465        );
466    }
467
468    /**
469     * Accepts the current selection: the caller will read {@link #getFilteredRecordings()}.
470     * <p>
471     * This must clear {@code cancelled}. It previously shared a single {@code closeAction()}
472     * with the Cancel button and the window's close box, which set {@code cancelled = true} —
473     * so Apply took the cancel path, {@code isCancelled()} always returned {@code true}, and
474     * {@code ViewerFrame.onFilterRequested} never applied the filter. Applying a filter did
475     * nothing at all.
476     */
477    private void applyAction() {
478        cancelled = false;
479        dispose();
480    }
481
482    /**
483     * Discards the selection. Used by the Cancel button and by the window's close box, which
484     * is deliberately made to behave the same as Cancel.
485     */
486    private void cancelAction() {
487        cancelled = true;
488        dispose();
489    }
490}
